tasks.description: Build an internal, bounded account-deletion media inventory for canonically owned private photos.
constraints: Internal local read-only SQL projection and test only. Return valid exact unified diff in JSON. Controller applies and verifies. No HTTP, storage/media deletion, token revocation, staging, background worker, accounts, billing, or role grants beyond revocation. No existing migration edits.

Define an internal function taking deleting owner UUID and optional photo UUID cursor, only for a canonical queued 060 request on a permanent deleting profile. Reuse accepted 035/037 storage canonical validation and in-flight diagnostics/upload/claim safety patterns where applicable. Page at most twenty safe, exact owned private analysis-inputs original photo IDs in UUID order, never arbitrary storage paths, other owners or catalogue. Treat noncanonical legacy/ambiguous keys and active transfer/worker/upload lease cases as blocked/waiting with counts so later purge cannot mark complete while media survives. Preserve external holds and no unknown fallback, no writes. Restrict this initial packet to photo_assets inventory; owner installation/draft orphan paths, object cleanup, final DB purge and workers remain open.

Use version-compatible focused pgTAP in the existing gate-covered auth_registration_profile.test.sql. Verify no projection without a queued deleting owner, canonical owned private photos only, at-most-20 ordered pagination, waiting for a live lease/ticket, blocked unsafe original/thumbnail key without leaking it, foreign and catalogue isolation, no source mutation or client/service execution. Preserve older tests and leave T082/T083 open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Read projection change scoped to forward migration and focused fixture.
PostgreSQL clean and upgrade prove safe scope, pagination and no writes.
